description: This Java source file defines the final class AutoClosingSlf4jLogger, which implements the AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger interface. The class wraps an underlying AutoCloseableSlf4jLogger instance and provides logging methods that automatically close the logger resource after each log operation, ensuring diagnostic context is discarded properly. It includes methods for setting and discarding correlation IDs, MDC entries, and various logging level methods (trace, debug, info, warn, error) with support for markers and message formatting.
